compute_embedding_loss: compute cross-entropy loss for estimated embeddings given annotated mesh vertices using EmbeddingLoss
initialize_embedding_loss: initialize an EmbeddingLoss instance from a Detectron2 CfgNode config with gauss sigma parameter
extract_vertex_embeddings: extract normalized vertex embeddings at interpolated points using BilinearInterpolationHelper and predictor outputs
compute_fake_values: compute zero-valued fake loss tensors for mesh names not present in the current batch
compute_squared_distance_scores: compute unnormalized scores from squared Euclidean distance matrix between vertex and mesh embeddings
